# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform compatibility and callback reliability**

## Highlights

Upcoming changes modernize Uno integration and correct native callback, stream-lifetime, and rendering behavior.

## Breaking Changes

- **Update Apple deployment targets** — Native assets require macOS 11.0 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 14.0. Managed iOS/tvOS minima rise to 14.0; managed macOS 12.0 and Mac Catalyst 15.0 remain higher. Raise application deployment targets to satisfy every applicable framework and native requirement rather than lowering them to the native floor. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Migrate Uno views to Uno Platform 7** — Non-Windows Uno views require Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10; pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines are no longer supported. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, uses a raster fallback, returns null GRContext, and drops RaiseOnUnsupported. Use SKCanvasElement for Uno GPU rendering and migrate WASM builds to the .NET SDK. The Windows facade remains ANGLE-backed. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Keep SKData.CreateCopy lengths within the source array** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source buffer instead of depending on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct native boolean callbacks** — Uses one-byte native booleans for Skia callbacks and four-byte hb_bool_t values for HarfBuzz callbacks, fixing false-return handling while public managed delegates retain bool signatures. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Linux HarfBuzz load-order isolation** — Binds internal bundled HarfBuzz function calls locally to avoid incompatible system-library preemption, such as when GTK loads HarfBuzz first. Exported hb_* entry points and managed signatures remain unchanged. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Display-paced Android texture rendering** — Automatic continuous frames follow Choreographer display callbacks while drawing stays on the GL worker. Explicit render requests remain independent; this also applies to MAUI Android SKGLView.HasRenderLoop. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Native shader and GLES upload corrections** — Rejects Raster Pipeline slot-count overflows and invalid runtime-effect types earlier, and disables Ganesh BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads that are invalid in GLES. Readback behavior is unchanged. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **Reliable WebGPU application linking** — Bundles Dawn C++ support inside libSkiaSharp.a instead of compiling it on the application link line, avoiding C/C++ flag conflicts. JavaScript glue remains a link input; custom native archives must include the rebuilt support. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Character-code and string validation** — StringUtilities decodes by encoded unit width: ASCII for Utf8, BMP for Utf16, and a single code point for Utf32. Empty, multi-character, or multi-unit inputs are rejected; null byte arrays now raise ArgumentNullException. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Release borrowed front-buffered streams** — Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to a borrowed stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. It does not dispose that stream; the caller retains disposal responsibility. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Reduced image and shaping allocations** — Valid managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation, HarfBuzz UTF-32 string encoding uses a pooled buffer, and feature-string formatting avoids a native allocation while preserving decoding. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Updated Windows integration baseline** — Aligns library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 and Windows SDK BuildTools 10.0.22621.756. Rebuilds ANGLE from chromium/8118 and keeps packaged Windows PDB names discoverable; the declared WinUI runtime minimum is unchanged. ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321))
